reply.content: Claim CLM-24-10031 was denied with CO-197 because the authorization was absent from the claim. Authorization AUTH-55821 was obtained on 2026-02-27, before the 2026-03-04 date of service. Policy NWH-RAD-004 version 3 allows a corrected claim that includes the authorization number within 90 days of the denial. Next action: submit a corrected claim with authorization AUTH-55821.

Claim CLM-24-10047 was denied with CO-29 for timely filing. The claim was submitted within the 180-day timely filing limit, so the denial is a payer error. Next action: appeal and ask Northwind to reprocess the claim and pay the contracted rate of $430.00.

Claim CLM-24-10052 was denied with CO-50 for medical necessity. Policy NWH-PT-020 covers up to 30 therapy visits per year, so this visit should be covered. Next action: appeal with a letter of medical necessity.
